baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ joins the detachable yield named by ق ط ف to the nearness predicated by د ن و.
baseline_models.mechanism: The produce is not merely visible nearby. A low, pickable cluster plus practical nearness places the yield at the recipient's point of action, collapsing the effort normally required to approach or climb to it.

activation_trace.role: Picked fruit or a low-hanging cluster supplies the concrete yield and makes accessibility intrinsic to the noun.
Nearness and approximation turn the low cluster into practical reach, completing the access mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Its fruit clusters are spatially nearby.
changed_reading.after: Its yield is already presented within picking reach, so abundance arrives as immediately usable access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُطُوفُهَا can name the harvest and its time, while دَانِيَةٌ repeats the motion of drawing near.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots form a temporal convergence: the picking season approaches or has arrived, and the fruit is correspondingly ready. Nearness therefore marks ripeness and timeliness as well as distance.

activation_trace.role: Harvest time drawing near or arriving supplies a temporal reading of the yield's readiness.
Nearness reinforces arrival of the usable moment, not only shortening of space.

changed_reading.before: The clusters occupy a close location.
changed_reading.after: The moment of harvest itself has come close: the yield is ripe now, with no interval between promise and use.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The low-hanging cluster of قُطُوفُهَا is qualified by دَانِيَةٌ, whose inventory includes an upper body bending toward its middle.
baseline_models.mechanism: The geometry assigns movement to what is above: the bearer bends its yield down toward the embodied receiver. Accessibility becomes accommodation by the environment rather than exertion by the eater.

activation_trace.role: The low-hanging cluster supplies an upper yield capable of being presented downward.
An upper part bent toward the middle supplies the downward bodily geometry and assigns accommodation to the canopy.

changed_reading.before: The eater must approach nearby produce.
changed_reading.after: The upper growth appears to bend toward the eater, reversing ordinary acquisition so the provision performs the approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: A written determination is given into the right hand and its account is expected; the sequence then resolves into satisfied life, a high garden, and reachable fruit. The focus can therefore function as execution of a favorable record: adjudicated status becomes edible, usable access rather than remaining documentary information.

activation_trace.role: The low accessible cluster supplies the material benefit into which the favorable record resolves.
Practical nearness makes the recorded outcome executable and usable by its recipient.
Giving and bestowal supply the transfer that begins with the record and culminates in accessible provision.
A written fixing that obliges a judgment supplies the adjudicative state later materialized as fruit access.
The right hand supplies the bodily site of favorable receipt and gives nearness a hand-scale consequence.
Counting and account supply the settlement mechanism whose positive result becomes tangible yield.

structural_cues: 69:19-20 moves from receipt and public reading of the book to anticipated encounter with the account.
69:21-23 then moves without a new subject from satisfied life to a high garden and its near produce.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a given right-hand record, an account, satisfied life, and reachable fruit; I infer the arrow favorable determination -> material execution. The live alternative is simple narrative sequence, with the fruit illustrating reward but not specifically enacting the record.

changed_reading.before: The fruit is an environmental pleasure in the garden.
changed_reading.after: The reachable fruit is the favorable account made operational: a written outcome has become provision the recipient can immediately use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden branch supplies a space covered by dense tree growth while ع ل و places it high. Joined to the focus's low cluster and the bending image of د ن و, the apparent contradiction becomes vertical accommodation: an elevated, enclosing canopy brings its own yield down into the receiver's middle zone.

activation_trace.role: A low-hanging cluster supplies the edible endpoint beneath the elevated canopy.
An upper part bent toward the middle supplies the geometry by which height becomes accommodation.
A garden covered by trees supplies the overhead vegetative body that bears the focus produce.
Dense, interlacing plant growth supplies a continuous canopy capable of extending its clusters toward the eater.
Height and elevation create the vertical condition that the bending cluster resolves.

structural_cues: 69:22 and 69:23 are adjacent nominal descriptions: the garden is high, then its produce is near.
The possessive suffix in قُطُوفُهَا binds the near yield to the high garden rather than describing an unrelated lower source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a high tree-covered garden, a low cluster, and an upper-to-middle bending image; I infer the canopy as the mediator of downward accommodation. The live alternative is that height expresses rank while nearness expresses location, with no physical bending mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Fruit happens to be close despite the garden's height.
changed_reading.after: The high garden accommodates the body below it: its dense upper growth bends the yield down, making elevation the source of reach rather than an obstacle to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's arriving harvest is followed by an imperative to consume tree-yield pleasantly because of what was advanced. The س ل ف inventory sharpens the causal phrase through both an advance before a meal and money paid ahead: prior conduct functions as an advance that has matured into a ready, trouble-free edible return.

activation_trace.role: Harvest time drawing near or arriving supplies maturation from an earlier interval into present readiness.
Nearness closes the temporal and practical gap between the advance and its usable return.
The yield of trees and crops identifies the commanded consumption as realization of the focus harvest.
Pleasantness without hardship makes the matured return frictionless rather than laborious or harmful.
An advance made before food supplies an exact meal-oriented bridge from prior action to present eating.
Money paid in advance supplies the transactional image of a return already settled before it becomes available.

structural_cues: 69:24 immediately follows the focus with plural imperatives to eat and drink and a بِمَا causal phrase linking enjoyment to what was previously advanced.
The past-oriented الأيام الخالية stands opposite the focus's present nominal availability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tree-yield, trouble-free consumption, a causal link to what was advanced, and branches for a pre-meal or monetary advance; I infer the arrow prior conduct -> matured edible return. The live alternative is recompense without either agrarian maturation or transactional payment imagery.

changed_reading.before: The harvest is ripe and temporally ready.
changed_reading.after: The near harvest is a return already advanced for in the former days: prior conduct has ripened into a prepaid, immediately consumable meal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus makes a detachable product available for easy taking; the contrasting scene takes the person and fixes a collar or shackle on the body. Agency reverses: in reward, the person remains an eater who acts on nearby yield, while in punishment the person becomes the seized and restrained object.

activation_trace.role: Picking or cutting a thing from its source supplies an acquisition in which the fruit, not the person, is acted upon.
Nearness preserves the recipient's agency by making acquisition available without pursuit or coercion.
Capture and seizure supply the punitive reversal in which the human, rather than the yield, is taken.
A collar or shackle fixed around a limb supplies restraint of the seized body's capacity to reach and act.

structural_cues: The positive sequence places near fruit before plural commands to eat and drink; 69:30 instead uses singular imperatives to seize and shackle the condemned person.
The grammatical patient changes from detachable produce implicit in picking to the human object of coercive commands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies easy pickability, seizure, and bodily restraint; I infer the agency arrow fruit acted upon -> eater remains agent, versus person acted upon -> person loses agency. The live alternative is only a broad contrast between reward and punishment without a specific acquisition reversal.

changed_reading.before: The cluster is easy for the eater to take.
changed_reading.after: Its pickability preserves the eater as agent and makes fruit the detachable object, the exact relational inverse of being seized and bodily restrained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near fruit is naturally calibrated by an outstretched arm, while the punitive scene turns the same bodily measure into a seventy-cubit chain and threads the person into it. The two spaces have opposite ergonomics: provision contracts to the body's reach, whereas restraint expands far beyond that reach and absorbs the body into its apparatus.

activation_trace.role: A low accessible cluster supplies the object normally gathered at arm's reach.
Practical nearness contracts the environment to the body's usable range.
Connected rings and parts supply the extended apparatus that opposes the simple fruit-to-hand relation.
The outstretched arm supplies the embodied scale by which the focus's nearness can be understood as reach.
Measurement by cubit turns that ordinary limb-scale into the quantified excessive length of the restraint.
Inserting one thing into another makes the person part of the chain topology instead of an agent reaching for an object.

structural_cues: 69:32 quantifies the chain as seventy cubits and then commands insertion of the person into it.
The focus gives no number because دانية expresses successful body-relative access rather than excessive absolute extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outstretched arm, cubit measurement, linked extension, bodily insertion, and accessible fruit; I infer the ergonomic contrast body reaches provision versus apparatus encloses body. The live alternative is that nearness is not specifically arm-scale and the cubit merely supplies a conventional unit.

changed_reading.before: Nearness means the fruit is within convenient reach.
changed_reading.after: Nearness defines a humane body-world fit: the environment contracts to the outstretched arm, opposite a seventy-cubit restraint into which the body is forcibly incorporated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The negative scene joins failure to mobilize feeding for the destitute with a radically restricted food supply. Against that relation, the focus's near pickings make access itself morally salient: provision in the positive scene is not withheld behind distance, status, or an intermediary but is placed directly at the eater.

activation_trace.role: The low accessible fruit supplies actual nourishment ready for a recipient rather than abstract abundance.
Nearness supplies the absence of a practical barrier between food and eater.
Urging toward an action supplies the social mobilization explicitly negated in the failure to promote feeding.
Feeding another or seeking food makes access to nourishment a relation between persons, not merely a private appetite.
The low condition of destitution identifies the person for whom food access had not been activated.
Provision, livelihood, and good condition supply what the exception construction in the punitive scene drastically denies.

structural_cues: 69:34 negates urging the feeding of the destitute, while 69:36 uses an exception to restrict food and 69:37 restricts its eaters.
The positive sequence instead places near fruit before the unrestricted plural command to eat and drink in 69:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed feeding, destitution, restricted punitive food, and reachable fruit; I infer the contrastive arrow from a blocked social food relation to ungated provision. The live alternative is that these are only separate outcomes for separate groups, without a distributive claim encoded by nearness itself.

changed_reading.before: The fruit is physically easy for its recipient to obtain.
changed_reading.after: Its nearness enacts an ungated food relation, reversing the scene in which feeding was not mobilized and food becomes both restricted and degrading.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus contains no explicit economic or political term. It remains anchored in دَانِيَةٌ as direct practical access and in context branches where sufficiency, accumulated wealth, and coercive authority fail; downstream prose should present it as a contrastive socioeconomic activation, not as an explicit abolition of ownership or exchange.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fruit's nearness makes nourishment directly reachable without naming an asset, purchase, or command structure.

activation_trace.role: Low-hanging accessible fruit supplies provision that can be used directly rather than converted from an asset.
Practical nearness removes a mediating distance between recipient and nourishment.
Sufficiency or avail supplies the failed function that wealth cannot perform in the contrasting scene.
Accumulating and possessing wealth supplies the asset mediator explicitly declared useless.
Power and delegated authority supply the command mediator that has vanished, sharpening the focus's immediate access.

changed_reading.after: Nearby fruit tentatively figures provision after wealth and authority cease to mediate: nourishment is available by proximity rather than capital or command.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because the context occurrences mean giving, expectation, and garden rather than biological gestation. It remains anchored through the focus branches for harvest time and near parturition, while the context inventories converge on emerging produce, hoped-for offspring, and a concealed fetus; downstream prose should qualify it as a maturation analogy, not claim that the garden is literally maternal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُطُوفُهَا can mark harvest time while دَانِيَةٌ carries an image of being near delivery, allowing ripeness to be modeled as imminent emergence.

activation_trace.role: Harvest time drawing near or arriving supplies the maturation event that is about to issue in usable yield.
Nearing parturition supplies the delivery image by which ripe yield is imminent emergence rather than static proximity.
Emergence of growth and produce supplies a context-backed transition from hidden maturation to outward yield.
A woman from whom a child is hoped supplies expectant futurity for the near-delivery model.
A fetus concealed in the belly supplies the hidden growth whose emergence parallels fruit reaching harvest.

changed_reading.before: The harvest has reached its proper time.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, ripeness behaves like near delivery: concealed growth has completed its term and is about to emerge as accessible yield.

strongest_changes: The right-hand record and account made the near fruit legible as a favorable determination converted into usable provision.
The high tree-covered garden revised proximity into downward accommodation by an elevated canopy.
The temporal harvest became a prepaid meal because س ل ف contributes both an advance before food and money advanced, while 69:24 identifies tree-yield and trouble-free eating.
Seizure and shackling reversed the focus's agency relation: the rewarded person acts on fruit, whereas the condemned person becomes the acted-upon object.
The seventy-cubit chain made nearness an ergonomic body-world fit, contrasting fruit within arm range with a restraint that incorporates the body.
summary.what_was_special: The most diagnostic activations were functional convergences: document and account became edible execution, height became canopy accommodation, an advance became a matured meal, and ordinary reach became the positive inverse of seizure, excessive measure, and blocked feeding.
remaining_uncertainties: The high/near pair can describe rank plus proximity without requiring a physically bending canopy.
The prepaid-harvest model combines agrarian and transactional branches that may be parallel analogies rather than one mechanism.
The arm-scale, gestational, social, and economic readings are discourse or branch activations, not lexical entailments of the focus words.
Spatial reach, temporal ripeness, and receiver-directed accommodation can coexist, but the focus does not rank them.
